description_en: Queries the change records of rule group rules by paging
description_zh: 分页查询规则库规则变化记录
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-base-rule-change-log --instance-id waf-cn-mp91530000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBaseRuleChangeLog

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number to return when paging. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page when paging
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The language of the rule name. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置规则名称的语言属性，取值：

zh：表示规则名称为中文。
en：表示规则名称为英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

Rules.description_en: The list of rule group changes

CveId.description_en: The CVE ID of the vulnerability associated with the system rule
CveId.description_zh: 系统规则关联的漏洞CVE ID

Operation.description_en:
The operation type. Valid values:
add: added.
modify: modified
Operation.description_zh:
操作方式。取值范围：
add：添加。
modify：变更

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the rule was updated. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 规则的更新时间。Unix 时间戳格式，单位：毫秒（ms）

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of rule change records
